name: vehicle-file
title: Vehicle maintenance file
for_each: select id,code from vehicles where status<>'retired'

sections.title: Service history
sections.sql: select code,kind,done_on,odometer_km,workshop,notes from services where vehicle_id=$1 order by done_on desc

sections.title: Faults reported and repaired
sections.note: Daily check faults, who found them and how they were fixed.
sections.sql: select code,reported_on,reported_by,severity,description,status,repaired_on,repair_note from defects where vehicle_id=$1 order by reported_on desc

name: driver-file
title: Driver compliance file
for_each: select id,code from drivers where active

sections.title: Licences, medicals and training
sections.sql: select kind,name,reference,expires_on,evidence from credentials where driver_id=$1 order by expires_on nulls first

sections.title: Recorded work, last 14 days
sections.note: UTC. Totals per day; the standard hours check runs in the fatigue command.
sections.sql: select (starts_at at time zone 'UTC')::date as work_day,round(sum(extract(epoch from (ends_at-starts_at))/60))::int as work_minutes,count(*)::int as periods from work_periods where driver_id=$1 and starts_at>=now()-interval '14 days' group by 1 order by 1 desc

name: subcontractor-review
title: Subcontractor chain of responsibility review
for_each: select id,code from subcontractors where status='active'

sections.title: Loads in the last 90 days
sections.sql: select code,departs_at,origin,destination,mass_limit_kg,gross_mass_kg,restraint_checked,status from trips where subcontractor_id=$1 and departs_at>now()-interval '90 days' order by departs_at desc

sections.title: What happened
sections.sql: select i.code,i.occurred_on,i.kind,v.code as vehicle,d.name as driver,i.description from incidents i left join vehicles v on v.id=i.vehicle_id left join drivers d on d.id=i.driver_id where i.id=$1
